title: Quickly Braised Welsh Sausages Toad-in-the-Hole
description: Charred Welsh sausages cooked in a rich beer braise, served in a crispy Yorkshire pudding 'nest'. A hearty, paleo-friendly take on the British classic.
instructions: In a large, deep terracotta dish, combine the chopped onion, minced garlic, carrots, and celery. Drizzle with a little coconut oil and toss to coat.
Add the Welsh sausages to the dish, tucking them in among the vegetables.
Pour in the beer, leaving about 1 inch of space at the top of the dish.
Dust the top of the sausages with a little all-purpose flour.
Bake in the preheated oven for about 25 minutes, or until the sausages are nicely browned and the vegetables are tender.
While the sausages are cooking, whisk together the eggs and soda water in a small bowl.
Remove the dish from the oven and carefully pour the egg mixture over the sausages and vegetables.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the Yorkshire pudding is puffed and golden.
Carefully remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to carefully loosen the edges of the Yorkshire pudding from the dish.
Slide the dish onto a serving platter and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh thyme sprigs and enjoy!
